title: Two vehicles are attempting to park at same spot causing congestion.
situation: Two vehicles are attempting to park at same spot causing congestion.
communication_type: Inter Vehicle & Traffic Signal Communication, Between Pedestrian and Detector present roadside
description: Two vehicles are attempting to stop by a single parking spot thus causing congestion for others as both vehicles will eventually come to a hault, with or without resolution (Consider Vehicle 1 to be the one which has moved over the space, and Vehicle 2 to be the one which is yet to successfully stop by the place).
dialogue_prompts: 1. Vehicle 1 haults, attempts to revers, but due to vehicle 2 is unable to do so, consequently requests traffic signal for resolution (info-seeking). 2. Traffic signal finds next nearest parking space and redirects vehicle 1 to the spot, avoiding reversing maneuver and swiftly resolving the congestion (Deliberation). 3. Traffic signal tells vehicle 2 to wait for some moments until Vehicle 1 can be redirected (Deliberation).
cascading_problems: 1. Vehicle 1 may not always agree to move to next stop. 2. Vehicle 1 may have certain special priveledge to park at the spot.
